subject: Pub Shirts
author: Abernyte
body:
Given the t-shirts for the trucking company and the gym I'm surprised we haven't seen a shirt for one of the little diners & bars around Paradise. Or even the ribs place. Seems like anyplace you go here in the states that is the least bit touristy, or sells beer, has t-shirts on sale.

Something that most people wouldn't recognize as being from a game would be a nice addition and a good inside joke for players.

subject: Design Your Own Merchandise
author: ZombieTron
body:
As the CG Merch is using Zazzle and is basically just designs that you can put on anything, it is definitely easy enough to design your own Burnout merchandise.

I really liked the baseball cap that Silent made with the Awesome rating stars on it... I tried to find a pic but failed. I think a pic was posted on the CG forums.

If you do have time on your hands and make a cool Burnout T-shirt design please share it with us, as I am not overly keen on the official options. I hope some fans do take the time to make their own and send them into CG, it would be cool if they extend the Zazzle range to include fan's designs.

Has anybody bought anything yet? hmm that's given me a new idea for a poll!
